instruction:
Compare the international Economy cabin-baggage rules shown at run time by ANA, JAL at https://www.jal.co.jp/jp/en/inter/baggage/inflight/ and Singapore Airlines at https://www.singaporeair.com/en_UK/gb/travel-info/baggage/cabin-baggage/. Use flights operated by the named carrier, without codeshares, status exceptions or special items. Record piece count, per-dimension and summed-dimension limits, weight scope, personal-item rules and stowage caveats. Screen six single carry-on bags against all three carriers: 55x40x20cm/7kg; 56x36x23cm/6kg; 55x40x25cm/6kg; 50x35x25cm/8kg; 50x35x20cm/10kg; and 50x35x20cm/10.1kg. Then screen three pairs against all three: a 55x40x20cm/7kg main bag plus a 30x20x10cm/1kg handbag; the same-size main bag at 9kg plus that handbag at 2kg; and a 55x40x20cm/6kg main bag plus a 40x30x15cm/1kg briefcase. All dimensions include handles and wheels; assume the small handbag/briefcase fits under the seat, but still apply explicit carrier dimensions. Show dimension sums and relevant combined weights. Give meets published limits, exceeds limits or insufficient information, with controlling citations; distinguish numeric compliance from guaranteed cabin acceptance. Finish with three differences in weight, dimension or personal-item treatment. Do not obtain a quote or book travel.

Stopping condition: Stop when three policy rows, eighteen single-bag screens, nine paired-bag screens and three cited rule differences are complete.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.
